title: DAST scan scope
description: Bounds a single DAST scan: which app, which environment tier, which hosts may/must-never be contacted, and which actions must never be triggered.

app_id.description: Application identifier; must match app_id in detection records.

environment_class.description: Target tier. 'prod' is intentionally excluded so the runner can never scan production (FR-S3 / NFR-2).

target_fqdn.description: Primary host of the app under test. Should also appear in fqdn_allow_list (enforced by the validate CLI).

fqdn_allow_list.description: Exact hosts the scanner may contact. Any in-flight request to a host not listed here is blocked (FR-S4).

fqdn_deny_list.description: Hosts that must never be contacted; hard-blocks even if otherwise allowed.

avoid_action_list.description: Actions the crawler/scanner must never trigger, matched per the documented rule (e.g. URL substring).
